prompt: An upside-down village hanging from a cliff overhang.

card.name: Overhang Hanging Village

site.text: An upside-down village hanging from a cliff overhang, buildings suspended beneath the rock ceiling

style.text: Rustic timber and stone, lanterns and chains, built to hang from above

purpose.text: A secluded home base village living beneath a cliff overhang

card.interpretation: Site is a village hung beneath a cliff overhang, using an existing overhang if one is found. Style is rustic timber and stone with chains and lanterns. Purpose is a quiet home base. The program is a hall, hanging cabins, a winch house, a lookout, a chain workshop and a ceiling garden, all suspended from the rock above.
assumptions: Rustic style chosen as the prompt gave none
Needs an existing overhang; terrain left as find

program.notes: Largest hanging building, chained to the overhang ceiling; the communal heart with lantern-lit windows.
Small cabins inverted from the rock ceiling, roofs against the stone, floors facing the drop.
Lift and rope station linking the village to the cliff top and ground.
Slim tower hanging down from the overhang edge for watching the valley.
Forges chains and fittings that keep the village hanging; connects homes via bridges.
Glow berries and vines grown from the ceiling as food source.
